2026-2027 Academic Calendar

  1. RIT/
  2. Academics/
  3. Academic Calendar
FALL 2026 (Term ID: 2261)
August 24, 2026 (Monday) Classes begin
First day of Add/Drop period †
August 29 Saturday classes begin
August 31 (Monday) Last day of Add/Drop period †
September 1 (Tuesday) First day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
September 7 (Monday) Labor Day - University Closed
September 13 21-Day Enrollment Reporting (Census Date)
October 12-13 Fall Break - No Classes
November 6 (Friday) Last day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
November 25 No classes - University closes at 2 p.m.
November 26-27 Thanksgiving Holiday - University closed*
December 7 (Monday) Last day of classes
Graduation: Deadline to apply online for Fall 2026 graduation
December 8 (Tuesday) Reading Day
Dec. 9,10,11,14,15,16 Final exams
December 18 (Friday) Final grades due
Dec. 19 - Jan. 10 Break between Fall Semester and Spring Semester
Dec. 25 - Jan. 1 RIT Designated Employee Holidays
Back to Top
 
SPRING 2027 (Term ID: 2265)
January 11, 2027 (Monday) Classes begin
First day of Add/Drop period †
January 16 Saturday classes begin
January 18 (Monday) Martin Luther King Jr Day - No classes
January 19 (Tuesday) Last day of Add/Drop period †
January 20 (Wednesday) First day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
January 31 21-Day Enrollment Reporting (Census Date)
March 7-14 Spring Break - No Classes
April 1 (Thursday) Graduation: Last day to apply to graduate to be included in the Commencement Book
April 2 (Friday) Last day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
April 26 (Monday) Last day of classes
Graduation: Deadline to apply online for Spring 2027 graduation
April 27 (Tuesday) Reading Day
Apr. 28,29,30, May 3,4,5 Final exams
May 7 (Friday) Final grades due
May 7-8 Convocation and Commencement ceremonies
May 9-11 Break between Spring Semester and Summer Term
Back to Top
 
SUMMER 2027 (Term ID: 2268)
May 12, 2027 (Wednesday) Classes begin
First day of Add/Drop period †
May 15 Saturday classes begin
May 19 (Wednesday) Last day of Add/Drop period †
May 20 (Thursday) First day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
May 31 (Monday) Memorial Day - University closed
June 18 (Friday) Juneteenth observed - University closed
July 5 (Monday) Independence Day observed - University closed
July 21 (Wednesday) Last day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
August 4 (Wednesday) Last day of classes
Graduation: Deadline to apply online for Summer 2027 graduation
August 5 Reading Day
August 6,9,10 Final exams
August 12 (Thursday) Final grades due
August 13-22 Break between Summer Term and Fall Semester
Back to Top
 
SUMMER 2027: Short Session 1
May 12, 2027 (Wednesday) Classes begin
First day of Add/Drop period
May 17 (Monday) Last day of Add/Drop period
May 18 (Tuesday) First day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
May 31 (Monday) Memorial Day - University closed
June 17 (Thursday) Last day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
June 18 (Friday) Juneteenth observed - University closed
June 23 (Wednesday) Last day of classes
June 24-25 Final exams
June 28 (Monday) Final grades due
Back to Top
 
SUMMER 2027: Short Session 2
June 28, 2027 (Monday) Classes begin
First day of Add/Drop period
July 5 (Monday) Independence Day observed - University closed
July 6 (Tuesday) Last day to Add/Drop classes
July 7 (Wednesday) First day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
July 28 (Wednesday) Last day to drop from classes with a grade of "W"
August 4 (Wednesday) Last day of classes
August 5 Reading Day
August 6,9,10 Final exams
August 12 (Thursday) Final grades due
Back to Top
 

† The Add/Drop period is the first seven class days of the Fall, Spring, and full Summer terms, excluding Sundays and holidays.
* No Saturday classes due to the Thanksgiving holiday break. Classes resume November 30, 2026.
